items.title: Prediction: Eli Lilly’s $92 Billion Revenue Outlook Could Be Just the Beginning

items.title: How GLP 1 Coverage Could Send You Beyond XLV
items.summary: Two of these healthcare funds could not be more different once you look under the hood. IHE keeps about 99.5% in pharmaceuticals, while XLV has roughly 37.2% in that industry and the bulk spread across biotechnology, health care equipment and services. That split matters now because government backed coverage of GLP-1 drugs is tied to an estimated US$18b budget hit, and families are spending around US$500 less a year on groceries.
